correctness.summary: The asymmetric construction has three balanced parts, its degree classes all meet n+t under n>=3t+p+q, and its only triangles are A1-B1-C2 and A3-B2-C1, giving exactly F_t(p)+F_t(q). The sqrt(2) threshold follows from the exact factorization F_t(u)/t^3-2=(u/t-1)(2-(u/t)^2) on the relevant branch. Direct graph verification found no discrepancy.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Fang--Xu (2026) uses the same parameter p on both sides and obtains 2F_t(p), optimized near phi t; Bollobas--Erdos--Szemeredi (1975) gives the older 4t^3 construction. Searches under exact, synonymous, asymmetric and sqrt(2)-threshold formulations found no two-parameter p,q formula or the n>=4t+floor(sqrt(2)t)+1 counterexample range. The bipartite gadget and symmetric special cases are not claimed as new.

value.summary: The construction lowers the leading order threshold for known counterexamples to the proposed 4t^3 bound from 3+2phi approximately 6.236 to 4+sqrt(2) approximately 5.414, substantially narrowing the gap to the conjectural n>=5t boundary.

limitations: The result is an upper-bound construction and does not determine f(n,t).
Optimality is proved only within the displayed two-parameter family.
The bipartite gadget and symmetric special case are prior work.
The recency of the source preprint leaves residual parallel-work and revision risk.
Finite verification supports but does not replace the symbolic proof.
Independent audit has not been performed.
